description: Use this when the user wants the details of one nomado24 posting, found through search_jobs or given as a nomado24 posting link: summary, employment type, seniority, skills, salary and where the salary figure comes from, and when the posting was last verified. Pass the job id from search_jobs, or the slug that ends a nomado24 posting URL. Do not use it to search for jobs. Returns the complete v2 payload with per-field provenance (dataOrigin: who asserted each field, by which method, when), salaryOrigin, firstSeenAt, lastVerifiedAt with its verification method, and updatedAt (the last genuine content change). Returns an error result for an id that is not a live posting; expired and withdrawn postings are not served. Read-only, free access. No blanket content licence; retain attribution and respect third-party rights (see structuredContent.attribution).

id.description: Job id as returned by search_jobs ('job_<slug>'). A bare slug is also accepted
